title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: Service Request Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to request establishment of bearers for user data or signaling.

entities.name: SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate service request procedure.

entities.name: EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message used for CS fallback or 1xCS fallback service requests.

entities.name: CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST
entities.description: Message used for control plane service requests.

entities.name: SERVICE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject a service request.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate attach procedure.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate tracking area update procedure.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EMM state where no NAS signaling connection exists.

entities.name: Lower layer failure
entities.description: Condition when lower layer indicates failure before service request completion.

entities.name: Protocol error in service request message
entities.description: Condition when SERVICE REQUEST, EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST or CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST contains protocol errors.

entities.name: Different information elements in subsequent service requests
entities.description: Condition when information elements differ between subsequent service request messages.

entities.name: Same information elements in subsequent service requests
entities.description: Condition when information elements are identical between subsequent service request messages.

entities.name: Abort service request procedure
entities.description: Network behavior to terminate ongoing service request procedure.

entities.name: Continue service request procedure
entities.description: Network behavior to continue with existing service request procedure.

relations.description: Lower layer failure causes network to enter/stay in EMM-IDLE state.
Protocol error in service request message triggers SERVICE REJECT response.
Different IEs in subsequent service requests cause abortion of previous procedure.
Same IEs in subsequent service requests cause continuation of existing procedure.
ATTACH REQUEST received during service request procedure may cause abortion.
TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST received during service request procedure may cause abortion.
